Findings submitted and accepted (batch `5fb492ad…`), covering the three required areas:

1. **Timing (supported)** — baseline uses only closes at/before t, needs the full trailing window per `closes_required_per_signal` with only recorded warm-up exclusions, executes no earlier than the next observed close (last-row signal has none), no date filling, and next-close counts don't establish tradability.
2. **Coverage (supported)** — unadjusted close-only convenience sample, current download (not a vintage archive), never a holdout, no volume/corporate-actions/calendar/costs/point-in-time universe, and close-only jumps cannot justify a jump or corporate-action screen.
3. **Normalization (hypothesis)** — one unproven alternative: baseline lookback/direction plus realized-volatility normalization over the smallest permitted window (positive trailing SD required; all-zero windows ineligible), with trade-offs (added parameter, deeper warm-up, changed score scale) and required future evidence stated; baseline retention left equally acceptable.
